castAddBody.text:
most of the tl suggests using jev-like model, or harness-level intelligence, to route requests to appropriate models

OpenRouter's raison d'etre is based on this paradigm

some ppl (theo, kun chen) push back, pointing out that request-level routing is likely to be inefficient

it's all v confusing

my solution is self-contained agents in prod:
- each gets its own personality and skills set
- each runs in its own container
- hard-coded set of models
- balanced for cost, performance, and privacy

my workhorses are 
- Cursor / Grok on a coding sub
- Zhipu glm-5.3-flash on a coding sub
- Venice glm-4.7-flash at $0.06/M input, 0.40/M output

Never send sensitive info to a frontier model, only to a trailing open-weights model

OK to do research with a creepy frontier model, but don't try creating unless it's expected to be slop

What this all gets me: never wait, never run out of tokens, sleep ok knowing my personal data never goes into the soup
